M-WIDGET-TREE.Purpose: Keyed Widget instance hierarchy, parent/child references, layout nodes, identity-preserving moves and a stable sibling paint-order view.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: WidgetTree create, remove and move instances and their Flexbox nodes.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Instance lookups, ancestor traversal and stable GetChildrenInPaintOrder.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Rendering and hit-testing traversal — owned by M-WIDGET-ENGINE and M-TRANSFORM-SERVICE.

Requirements.REQ-001: Matching declaration keys preserve instance identity across reconciliations.
Requirements.REQ-002: RemoveInstance unlinks references so removed instances are collectable; OnUnmount runs before releasing subscriptions and owned Behaviors.
Requirements.REQ-003: GetChildrenInPaintOrder orders by increasing ZIndex.Value and retains declaration order for equal values without mutating the instance Child list.
Requirements.REQ-004: Paint ordering reads current Behavior.Value, including animated/computed values, independently of Flexbox layout invalidation.

Outputs.OUT-001: Widget instances and Flexbox nodes with parent/child links and ordered paint view.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Instance creation invokes OnMount; removal invokes OnUnmount and releases instance ownership.
